alts.hero: Athlete silhouette stepping through a walking lunge while holding dumbbells
alts.start: Walking lunge start position: standing tall with dumbbells held beside the body
alts.finish: Walking lunge finish position: both knees bent with the front heel planted

alts.hero: Athlete silhouette lifting the hips into a controlled glute bridge
alts.start: Glute bridge start position: lying on the back with knees bent and hips near the floor
alts.finish: Glute bridge finish position: hips raised until the trunk and thighs form a straight line

alts.hero: Athlete silhouette driving a barbell upward in a hip thrust against a bench
alts.start: Barbell hip thrust start position: upper back on the bench with hips lowered
alts.finish: Barbell hip thrust finish position: hips fully raised with the barbell over the pelvis

alts.hero: Athlete silhouette performing a dead bug with opposite arm and leg extending
alts.start: Dead bug start position: lying on the back with arms raised and hips and knees bent
alts.finish: Dead bug finish position: one arm and the opposite leg extended while the back stays supported

alts.hero: Athlete silhouette curling the lower legs downward on a seated leg curl machine
alts.start: Seated leg curl start position: seated with the legs extended against the machine pad
alts.finish: Seated leg curl finish position: heels drawn down and back with knees flexed

alts.hero: Athlete silhouette extending the knees on a leg extension machine
alts.start: Leg extension start position: seated with knees bent and shins behind the machine pad
alts.finish: Leg extension finish position: legs extended forward with the quadriceps contracted

alts.hero: Athlete silhouette rising onto the toes during a standing calf raise
alts.start: Standing calf raise start position: heels lowered with the balls of the feet supported
alts.finish: Standing calf raise finish position: heels raised as high as control allows

alts.hero: Athlete silhouette bringing cable handles together in a chest fly
alts.start: Cable chest fly start position: standing between the towers with the arms open
alts.finish: Cable chest fly finish position: hands brought together in front of the chest

alts.hero: Athlete silhouette pulling a rope attachment toward the face
alts.start: Face pull start position: arms extended toward a cable set near face height
alts.finish: Face pull finish position: rope pulled toward the face with the hands separated

alts.hero: Athlete silhouette pressing a cable rope downward with the elbows held close
alts.start: Triceps pushdown start position: elbows bent with the rope near the upper abdomen
alts.finish: Triceps pushdown finish position: elbows extended with the rope pressed toward the thighs

alts.hero: Athlete silhouette controlling a dumbbell through an overhead triceps extension
alts.start: Overhead triceps extension start position: arms extended with the dumbbell above the head
alts.finish: Overhead triceps extension finish position: elbows bent with the dumbbell lowered behind the head

alts.hero: Athlete silhouette curling dumbbells with a neutral hammer grip
alts.start: Hammer curl start position: standing with the dumbbells beside the thighs and palms facing inward
alts.finish: Hammer curl finish position: dumbbells curled upward while the elbows remain close to the torso

alts.hero: Athlete silhouette curling a barbell upward without swinging the torso
alts.start: Barbell curl start position: standing with the bar held near the thighs and arms extended
alts.finish: Barbell curl finish position: bar raised toward the chest with elbows kept near the sides

alts.hero: Athlete silhouette curling the trunk downward during a kneeling cable crunch
alts.start: Cable crunch start position: kneeling upright with the rope held beside the head
alts.finish: Cable crunch finish position: ribcage curled toward the pelvis while the hips stay controlled

alts.hero: Athlete silhouette rowing a dumbbell toward the hip while supported on a bench
alts.start: Single-arm dumbbell row start position: supported on a bench with the working arm extended
alts.finish: Single-arm dumbbell row finish position: dumbbell pulled toward the hip without rotating the torso
